div.div:
T0 注册完成
napi_define_class → NapiDefineClass → NapiCreateClassFunction
NapiGetKeysAndAttrsFromProps 填 keys[] / attrs[]；FunctionRef::NewConcurrentClassFunctionWithName 创建 descs[]；CreateClassFuncWithProperties / NewClassFuncProtoWithProperties 创建 HClass、LayoutInfo、prototype 并填 slot
[拟新增] RegisterLazyClass / PublishLazySlot 发布 lifetime、directory、recipe；DestructDesc / DestructAttr + free 回收临时结构

div.div:
T1 首次读取与物化
PropertyLookup → [拟新增] NapiLazyGet
创建 MaterializationContext；LookupAndAcquireGuard + CAS 取得 recipe
NapiNativeCreateFunction 创建/填 NapiFunctionInfo；FunctionRef::NewConcurrentWithName 创建 name String、JSFunction，经 SetFunctionExtraInfo / NewJSNativePointer 创建 native pointer 并设置 lexical env
[拟新增] SameSlotMaterializeWrite 同槽提交；MarkProtoChanged / NoticeThroughChain；发布 DONE，依次释放 recipe、guard、context

text.tspan: NewJSNativePointer 创建 native pointer 并设置 lexical env

div.div:
T2 稳态、覆盖与删除
JSTaggedValue::SetProperty → JSObject::SetProperty
DefinePropertyOrThrow → JSObject::DefineOwnProperty；DeleteProperty → JSObject::DeleteProperty
[拟新增] TerminateLazySlot 在 prototype 自有槽变更时先发布 replacement / deleted 终态，再等待本槽 guard 并释放 recipe；receiver shadow 不终止 prototype recipe
物化槽是普通数据属性；JSFunction / JSNativePointer / NapiFunctionInfo 走现有 GC / CommonDeleter

div.div:
T3 environment / module unload
NativeEngine::RunCleanupHooks → [拟新增] LazyMethodRegistryCleanup
发布 lifetime = DEAD，registry 拒绝新 lookup / guard；等待 in-flight guard = 0
逐槽发布终止并释放剩余 recipe；随后释放 slotDirectory、generation-safe token、ClassBindingLifetime，最后析构 registry
已物化函数图仍由 GC / CommonDeleter 管理；recipe.data non-owning，不释放外部资源

text.tspan: 发布 lifetime = DEAD，registry 拒绝新 lookup / guard；等待
逐槽发布终止并释放剩余 recipe；随后释放
已物化函数图仍由 GC / CommonDeleter 管理；recipe.data
